matrix.workload_profile: Per run: ~12 uw CLI calls (sweep-persistence, sweep-ratio, smart-money-flow, most-active, top-premium-trades, volume-vs-average, plus conditional cumulative-premium-flow and oi-trend/ΔOI fetches for the mega-cap filter and C4 tagging), ~80k tokens, ~4 min. The work is NOT pure filter-and-rank: it is ranking plus a conditional-verification protocol — cum-flow alignment checks on the index/mega-cap subset, OI-opening confirmation per surfaced name, artifact adjudication when tool labels contradict the tape (SNDK case), and honest-phrasing constraints on what the tools can actually prove. Output is a tagged narrative ledger (co_flag_present, opening_confirmed, invalidation per name) consumed by the candidate union and the quant's C4 gate.
precision_critical_duties: P1.5 misnomer rule: never claim per-day directional persistence from consistency_score (it is sessions_in_top/5, a participation share); must corroborate via smart-money-flow or multi-date cum-flow, else phrase as 'swept N of 5, net dominant_direction' only

Index/mega-cap hedge-flow filter: SPY/QQQ/IWM/SPXW + top-10 mega-caps may NOT enter persistence top-5 unless cumulative-premium-flow 30d aligns; on failure emit exact '[hedge-flow signature: sweep <dir> but cum_flow_30d <opposite> — not directional]' demotion

C4 opening-confirmed tagging with evidence string 'opening_confirmed: true|false (ΔOI <x> vs <vol>, oi_trend <state>)' — a false 'true' prevents the quant from halving the bullish_flow/bearish_flow class (scored blast radius)
co_flag_present: true|false tag per ticker so signal-confluence-quant knows which names carry scorable evidence beyond sweeps
Citation discipline (2026-06-06 P1.4): cumulative-premium-flow is NO-INFO standalone — alignment screen only, never standalone directional confirmation
Dividend-capture blind spot: deep-ITM sub-parity call sweeps near ex-div are arb, not conviction (NEE 2026-06-04)
P1.6 hard rule: no file writes, no report.md/decision.json, no watchlist mutation (2026-06-05 W23 incident class)
Disqualifier enforcement: single-day sweeps footnote-only; news-clustered and mixed-direction names excluded from primary calls; explicit invalidation per surfaced name
downgrade_failure_modes: Haiku/low-effort overclaim: reads consistency_score=0.8 and reports 'persistent 4 of 5 sessions in the same direction' — the exact P1.5-banned inference (score is participation share, not directional agreement); the overclaim flows into §2/§3/§7 prose and OI-build rubric-line evidence that the frozen /calibration-audit loop grades

Skipped conditional fetch: fails to run the cumulative-premium-flow 30d alignment check on SPY/QQQ/IWM/SPX, so the 2026-07-02 case ($24B of index sweeps correctly demoted as hedge flow by the premium model) instead ranks index hedge flow in the persistence top-5 and poisons the candidate union

False opening_confirmed: true emitted without ΔOI≥~20%-of-volume or oi-trend BUILDING evidence — the quant's C4 gate then does NOT halve the bullish_flow/bearish_flow class, silently inflating raw_score (this is the one lane where sweep-tracker errors reach scored arithmetic)

SNDK-class artifact acceptance: takes the tool's window-label 'bullish' dominant_direction at face value against a put-side OI tape instead of dismissing the label with evidence — wrong-direction candidate surfaced to the union
Cites cumulative-premium-flow as standalone directional confirmation in the narrative, violating 2026-06-06 P1.4 (tool is NO-INFO standalone, −3.5pp MC at n=136)

Haiku multi-constraint risk on P1.6: Phase-1 agents have historically written report/envelope/watchlist unprompted (2026-06-05 W23); the standing no-file-writes rule is precisely the instruction-following class Haiku is weakest at
Missed dividend-capture arb: deep-ITM sub-parity ex-div call sweeps on a high-div payer reported as bullish conviction (NEE-class false positive)
Dropped co_flag_present tags: quant cannot distinguish scorable co-flagged names from narrative-only sweep candidates, breaking the 2026-05-23 P0.3 handoff contract
matrix.weekly_delta: No — the weekly wiring is the same tool stack on the same 5-day persistence window with week-level framing (weekly-analysis.md §sweep-tracker); same sonnet/high applies, superseding the stale 'sonnet/thinking off — no synthesis' table entry.
matrix.rationale: Blast radius is mostly narrative (sweep-persistence earns 0 rubric points since 2026-05-23 P0.3), which biases DOWN from fable/opus — but it is not zero: the opening_confirmed tag drives the quant's C4 flow-class cap and the hedge-flow filter gates what enters the candidate union, so haiku is unsafe. Protocol density is high (~10 hard rules, several with exact annotation formats and refuse-to-overclaim semantics — P1.5, P1.4, C4, P1.6), and the observed premium-model wins (index hedge-flow demotion, SNDK label-vs-tape artifact dismissal) are skepticism behaviors — however, each is scaffolded by an explicit written procedure in the agent file rather than free-form judgment, which is exactly what current-gen Sonnet with a real reasoning budget handles well. High effort (not medium) is recommended because the wins that mattered live were conditional-verification and artifact-adjudication steps that get skipped first under a thin thinking budget; medium is the floor for routine days. Cost: 1 spawn/run at ~80k tokens makes sonnet/high a large saving vs inherited fable with bounded risk, since downstream quant/fundamentals/debate/risk stages still gate anything that reaches the top-5.

matrix.workload_profile: Heaviest Phase-1 tool user: ~29 tool calls / 124k tokens per run, cross-referencing 13 UW CLI signal sources (block-stratified DP, ticker-summary, largest, price-levels, extended-hours, institutional-accumulation, unusual-volume, volume-vs-average, OI increases/smart-positioning/oi-trend, cum-premium-flow, conviction-matrix) plus three advisory co-flag lanes (fz insider-clusters, C28 oi decrease-with-volume, C19 single-leg put scan). The work is convergence synthesis under a dense gate stack — not arithmetic — culminating in a ranked flag list whose 4+-signal/institutional-tier verdict directly feeds the rubric's single largest scored line (+3 accumulation conjunction) and whose distribution_flag is carried into decision.json for calibration grading.
precision_critical_duties: Block-stratified REQUIRED FIRST PASS: mega/block tier only, retail-tier prints must not contaminate the flag (no exceptions)
Conviction-matrix floor: only DIRECTIONAL_LONG with confidence_pct >= 50 passes; HEDGED_LONG / COVERED_CALL / DISTRIBUTION / MIXED all fail (2026-06-12 P1.4/P1.5)

C28 distribution_flag direction-aware attribution: only call-OI-decrease or put-OI-increase contradicts a long thesis; put-closes are confirming and must NOT be flagged; >= $100K institutional closing-premium floor; contract symbol + signed OI delta quoted in note
The 4+-signal alignment count that triggers the +3 LOAD-BEARING conjunction award downstream — a false 'institutional-tier confirmed' here manufactures false HIGH tiers
C19 bearish-side-only discipline: Tier-1 put AND DP-distribution co-flag; never treat single-leg CALL prints as a bullish accumulation co-flag; size/OI<0.5 = closing anti-signal
institutional-accumulation is single-day only — never pass or imply a --days window (the '5/10-day window' framing is a documented fiction); multi-day persistence comes from oi-trend --days>=5
cum-premium-flow is supporting evidence only, never the thesis carrier; check dividend-capture (deep-ITM sub-parity ex-div calls) and merger-arb before reading accretion as accumulation
Timestamp/venue artifact skepticism (e.g., closing-cross 20:00-20:22Z prints = benchmark flow, not accumulation) — unwritten but board-changing
Hard no-file-writes / no-watchlist rule (P1.6, written after this agent class violated it in W23)
Graceful-skip on fz / empty oi decrease-with-volume — advisory lanes never block or hard-fail the hunt
downgrade_failure_modes: Closing-cross-class artifact misses: on 2026-07-02 the 20:00-20:22Z timestamps were the only tell that the entire mega-tier buy tape was quarter-start benchmark flow; a weaker model reads it as genuine accumulation, emits multiple false '4+ aligned + institutional-tier confirmed' flags, and the quant awards the +3 conjunction line (the biggest single rubric award) -> false HIGH tiers, the exact tier-inversion failure the frozen rubric was rebuilt to stop

C28 misattribution regression: labeling a put-OI-decrease as 'call distribution / unwound' (verbatim the 2026-06-11 AAPL error the P1.4 rule was written against) or flagging sub-$100K retail closes; the corrupted distribution_flag flows into decision.json.calls[] and is graded by /calibration-audit Phase 6, poisoning the C28 promotion-gate evidence

Confidence-floor erosion: passing DIRECTIONAL_LONG at confidence_pct < 50 (the 15.1 coin-flip precedent) or accepting HEDGED_LONG on a name like BSX (correctly rejected live at mega-tier 0.362 sell) -> hedged distribution surfaced as accumulation

C19 side-discipline break: surfacing single-leg CALL prints as a bullish co-flag (explicitly forbidden, -9.7pp beta) or missing the Tier-1-put-AND-DP-all-sell bearish conjunction (the live KLAC catch)
Window-fiction reinvention: claiming a '5-day institutional fingerprint' from the single-day institutional-accumulation tool, re-introducing the exact fabricated framing P1.4 removed

Fluent-accretion overclaim on cum-premium-flow: reading deep-ITM sub-parity ex-div call premium (NEE 2026-06-04) or closed-tender DP buys (NUVL merger-arb class) as accumulation because the narrative is fluent — the refuse-to-overclaim behavior that degrades fastest on haiku/low-effort

Output-discipline break: Phase-1 agents including this one wrote report/envelope/watchlist unprompted in the 2026-06-05 W23 incident; the hard rule exists but weaker instruction-followers are the population that violated it
matrix.weekly_delta: No change — the weekly variant runs the same gate stack over an expanded 5d/10d window and feeds an even heavier weekly +3 OI line plus the same conjunction, so the stale 'sonnet / thinking off' entry is superseded, not confirmed.
matrix.rationale: Blast radius argues UP: this is not an advisory prose lane — its flag verdict is the input to the rubric's LOAD-BEARING +3 conjunction and its distribution_flag enters the calibration-graded envelope. Protocol density is the highest in Phase 1 (~10 hard rules, several written after live violations). The 2026-07-02 telemetry shows the premium model's value was judgment (closing-cross reclassification that changed the whole board read; honest zero-flag floor enforcement; BSX hedged-distribution rejection), which the framework says degrades fastest on weaker tiers — refuting the stale sonnet/pattern-match routing. However, fable is not required: downstream disconfirmation layers (quant cum-flow conditioning on the +3, fundamentals-gate, bear-researcher — which caught the NEE case) bound the damage of a rare miss, and opus is the deepest reliable reasoner below the fable tier at 1.7x sonnet on a 1x/run agent (~124k tokens x 6 runs/week — affordable vs fable). Per framework rule 5, opus/high recommended with sonnet/high as minimum_safe: sonnet 5's strong agentic tool-use should hold the mechanized gates (matrix floor, tier filter, $100K floor are now written as bright lines), but the unwritten artifact-skepticism layer is at risk there, and anything below high effort risks shallow direction-aware C28 reads — the exact P1.4 failure class.

matrix.workload_profile: Phase-1 alpha-finder, 1x/run (~89k tokens, 18 tool calls, ~4 min). Pulls 8 uw lanes, manually reconstructs a multi-date P/C z-score trajectory (tool has no date flag — 'rising' requires 2-3 dated calls compared by hand), applies a fail-closed gate stack (VRP gate from Step-0 context, backwardation-near-catalyst abort, regime gate, >=3-aligned-signals floor), and does mechanism attribution (Pan-Poteshman informed-flow continuation vs. index-level fear-extreme fade). Mostly disciplined rule-application and light comparison arithmetic, not open-ended synthesis; feeds the frozen -2 crowding rubric line plus advisory C19 short co-flags.
precision_critical_duties: Never assert 'rising' z-score from a single pc-ratio-zscore snapshot — must reconstruct trajectory from >=2-3 dated calls before the -2 scored crowding line can fire (2026-06-12 P1.5a)
Mandatory VRP gate: consume from Step-0 context (no re-fetch), state the gate result on every output, and abort the entire fade lane when VRP is negative
Pan-Poteshman mechanism discipline: single-name +/-2-sigma extremes are continuation-watch flags, NOT fades; standalone fade theses confined to SPY/QQQ index-level high-P/C fear extremes (P1.5b)
Fail-closed >=3-aligned-signals floor and BACKWARDATION-near-catalyst abort — do not output weak setups
Never call the deprecated uw screener put-call-extremes; PRIMARY is uw historical pc-ratio-zscore
C19 co-flag honesty: CALL_BETA_FADE_CHASE is bull-regime-conditional (reads CALL_UNVALIDATED outside bull); advisory 0-points, no promotion overclaim
Output discipline hard rule (P1.6): no file writes, no report.md/decision.json, no watchlist mutation (W23 incident class)
downgrade_failure_modes: Claims 'rising uw historical pc-ratio-zscore' from a single snapshot (level read passed off as trajectory) -> mis-fires the frozen -2 crowding line in the scored rubric; this is the exact level-vs-flip failure class that forced mechanization of the dealer +3 line (2026-06-12 P0.4)

Emits fade candidates despite negative VRP, or omits the per-output 'VRP gate' field — the 2026-07-02 premium-model win was the honest full-lane abort on this gate; weaker models' documented weakness is refusing-to-overclaim, so they surface 'weak setups' the definition explicitly forbids

Inverts the Pan-Poteshman rule: frames a single-name BULLISH_EXTREME (e.g. the AMAT case) as a fade-the-crowd short instead of an informed-flow CONTINUATION warning — flips the sign of the thesis fed into the -2 line and the C19 CONTRARIAN_SHORT co-flag
Treats CALL_BETA_FADE_CHASE as a default fade outside bull regime instead of downgrading it to CALL_UNVALIDATED (bull-regime-conditional rule, 2026-06-12 P0.5)
Calls the deprecated uw screener put-call-extremes instead of pc-ratio-zscore, losing the euphoria-vs-structural-hedge discrimination the v0.4.0 replacement exists for
Re-fetches uw risk market-regime / uw historical vrp instead of consuming Step-0 context, risking a gate decision inconsistent with the orchestrator's regime read
On haiku specifically: P1.6 output-discipline violation (unprompted file/watchlist writes — the 2026-06-05 W23 incident class the hard rule was written for)
matrix.weekly_delta: No — the weekly variant reads the multi-date z trajectory natively over covered_dates (easier, not harder, than the daily's manual reconstruction); sonnet/high holds for both.
matrix.rationale: Blast radius is real but bounded: one frozen scored line (-2 crowding, C13-routed, re-audited by signal-confluence-quant) plus 0-point advisory lanes — not an envelope/gate writer, so fable/opus is not warranted. Protocol density is high (VRP gate, trajectory-reconstruction rule, continuation-vs-fade mechanism, >=3-signal floor, deprecated-tool ban, no-write rule), but every discipline is spelled out verbatim in the definition; the observed premium-model wins (negative-VRP lane abort, manual trajectory reconstruction, AMAT continuation framing) are faithful applications of written rules, squarely within Sonnet 5's instruction-following strengths. Haiku is disqualified because the agent's entire value is skepticism and refusal — claiming 'rising' from a level and emitting weak setups are exactly haiku's overclaim failure modes, and they poison a scored line. Effort high (not the stale table's thinking-off) because the P1.5 trajectory rule postdates that entry and the mechanism-inversion discipline benefits from deliberate reasoning; medium is the floor at which the gate stack still reliably binds.

matrix.workload_profile: One spawn per run (~6/week), ~12 uw CLI calls and ~68k tokens over ~5 min. Work is mostly JSON parsing of IV term-structure/term-skew/flow output with rule-based classification into BUY VOL / SELL VOL / CALENDAR / SKIP per upcoming print, plus manual kink-reading off cleaned curves because the raw classifier is degenerate (everything prints BACKWARDATION/null-kink). Arithmetic is limited to threshold comparisons (front-end-iv-ratio 1.05/1.10, ≥15-contract tenor floors, C12 liquidity floor); synthesis feeds exactly one +1 scored rubric line plus advisory PEAD/implied-move prose.
precision_critical_duties: Substrate hygiene before the PRIMARY gate: drop expired + 0DTE buckets, enforce the >=15-contract tenor floor, and require kink-AT-earnings-expiry rather than bare BACKWARDATION (P1.3; the FDX 2026-06-11 full-size SELL VOL rested on an 11-contract tenor)
Term-skew tenor discipline: read back-month skew via --dte-target at a tenor PAST the earnings expiry, never sample the earnings DTE itself (tool defaults to 365)

SELL VOL sizing invariant: full size only when back-month skew is also stretched; front-only kink -> half size; disqualify entirely when back-month skew is flat, front-end-iv-ratio > 1.10, or analyst-vs-flow divergence > 2-sigma
front-end-iv-ratio gates: >1.05 routes BUY VOL vs CALENDAR; >1.10 blocks aggressive SELL VOL

PEAD containment: earnings_drift stays advisory 0-points (C7 NO_GO withheld), all four AND-conditions checked, Finnhub /calendar/earnings as primary date source (yahoo get_earning_dates is broken on this build)

Broken-substrate honesty: flag artifacts (e.g. implied_move_perc broken for large caps) and substitute with explicitly-labeled bounds instead of printing bogus numbers the calibration audit will grade
Output discipline (P1.6 hard rule): return findings to orchestrator only — no file writes, no report.md/decision.json, no watchlist mutation
downgrade_failure_modes: Haiku-class: samples term-skew at the earnings DTE (or lets the 365-day default stand un-noted) instead of passing --dte-target past the event, then sizes FULL SELL VOL on a bare front-month kink — exactly the FDX 2026-06-11 failure class the P1.3 rule was written to prevent

Haiku-class: takes the degenerate classifier labels at face value (all names print BACKWARDATION with kink_expiry: null) instead of dropping 0DTE/expired buckets, enforcing the >=15-contract floor and reading the kink manually — emitting BUY/SELL VOL verdicts on contaminated curves that flow into the +1 scored line

Haiku or low-effort sonnet: prints the broken implied_move_perc field verbatim for large caps instead of detecting the artifact and substituting event-tenor forward vol with an upper-bound label — a fluent overclaim the frozen-rubric /calibration-audit grades as a miss (honest nulls > fluent overclaims)

Haiku-class: PEAD leakage — assigns score_components points to earnings_drift candidates or drops the 'advisory, 0 pts' tag despite the C7 NO_GO withhold, or uses the broken yahoo get_earning_dates instead of Finnhub, producing verdicts against wrong event dates

Low-effort any tier: loses the honest-refusal wins — misses macro-bundling SKIPs (GS/MS/BLK reporting into CPI morning, 2026-07-02) and disqualifier #3 catches like the PEP PCR-0.077-vs--$30.9M-premium divergence warning, converting SKIPs into sized SELL VOL calls

Haiku-class: P1.6 violation risk — Phase-1 agents on this fleet have previously written report/envelope/watchlist files unprompted (2026-06-05 W23 incident); weakest-tier instruction-following is the documented failure class for this rule
matrix.weekly_delta: No model change: the weekly dual mandate (recap grading + 2-week lookahead with term-skew-aligned full-size gating) adds synthesis but no new precision-critical arithmetic — keep sonnet/high, matching the stale prior-art entry's intent.
matrix.rationale: Blast radius is moderate: earnings-scout controls one +1 rubric line and advisory prose, not envelope math or gates, and risk-monitor independently re-applies the panic gate — so fable/opus is not warranted for 6 spawns/week at 68k tokens. Protocol density is high but almost entirely proceduralized in the prompt (P1.3 hygiene algorithm, tenor rules, 1.05/1.10 thresholds, sizing invariant, PEAD withhold), which is squarely Sonnet 5's strength in multi-constraint agentic tool use. The premium-model wins observed live (degenerate-classifier workarounds, broken-field detection, bundling SKIPs) are the degrade-fastest skepticism class, so haiku is unsafe — it fails exactly on multi-constraint following and refusing-to-overclaim, and the scored line plus the FDX-class full-size SELL VOL risk make silent haiku errors costly. High effort preserves the manual curve-reading and artifact-detection judgment; medium is the floor below which the honest-refusal behavior (SKIPs, upper-bound labels) starts eroding.

matrix.workload_profile: One spawn per run (~11 uw CLI calls, 54k tokens, ~172s): pulls `options-structure gex`, `historical gex-time-series`, `expiry-heatmap`, `greek-screener` for SPY and QQQ, then performs a mechanical level read — locate ZGL, apply the ~5%-of-spot reliability rule with a fail-closed null-day fallback, identify call/put walls from the per-strike grid, map regime to a structure_bias line. Output is the §2 prose advisory (0 rubric points, excluded from calls[]) plus the fields the orchestrator copies into the typed `next_session_gex` envelope block (enum regime, levels, zgl_reliable, mandatory caveats). Parsing-dominant with light synthesis; no arithmetic beyond max/min over a strike grid.
precision_critical_duties: ZGL reliability rule: trust zero_gamma_level only within ~5% of spot; on null (FULLY_NEGATIVE days) or deep-OTM extrapolation, fall back to total_gex sign + spot-vs-wall and emit zgl_reliable=false — never fabricate a level
Never lead with `uw options-structure today-gamma-flip` (expired same-day expiry, garbage ZGL); primary source must be `uw options-structure gex` dte_max=45
Fail-closed disqualifiers: INSUFFICIENT_DATA -> report the gap; per-strike grid not covering spot -> do NOT emit call/put walls
Enum discipline for the typed next_session_gex block: regime must be exactly one of POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/FULLY_NEGATIVE/FULLY_POSITIVE, prose confined to `read`
Scope fence: SPY/QQQ next-session only — no IWM, no single names, no swing-horizon DEX/vanna/charm (escalate to dealer-positioning-strategist)
P1.6 hard rule: return findings to orchestrator only — no file writes, no report.md/decision.json, no watchlist mutation; plus the no-re-fetch rule for Step-0 anchors (vrp, iv-term-structure)
Mandatory caveat set every run (EOD-prior refresh in first 30-60min, gap risk cross-ref to event_risk, ETF-not-index book, 0-45d proxy) and no presentation of levels as a proven edge
downgrade_failure_modes: Haiku-class instruction slip: leading with `today-gamma-flip` despite the explicit prohibition and reporting its expired-expiry ZGL as the next-session level — the exact failure the rule was written against (definition file line 15)

Overclaiming on degenerate days: on a null/extrapolated ZGL (FULLY_NEGATIVE), a weaker model states a fabricated or deep-OTM level with zgl_reliable=true/omitted instead of executing the total_gex-sign fallback — this poisons the `next_session_gex` envelope block that `scripts/gex_next_session_backtest.py` grades in the weekly §2 backtest (refusing-to-state-a-level is haiku's documented weak axis)
Emitting call_wall/put_wall when the per-strike grid does not cover spot (disqualifier line 32: flag and do not emit) — invalid walls silently enter the walls-as-magnet hit-rate sample

Loss of the artifact-skepticism the premium model demonstrated 2026-07-02: propagating a label-engine regime (FULLY_NEGATIVE) verbatim into the typed enum despite a contradicting +GEX grid at 747+ — a silent wrong regime in the envelope with no downstream validator to catch it

Scope/discipline regressions of the historical Phase-1 class: drifting into IWM/single-name or swing-horizon vanna commentary (the horizon-bleed the agent split exists to prevent), re-fetching Step-0 anchors, or the 2026-06-05 W23 failure of writing files/watchlist unprompted
Dropping mandatory caveats or framing levels as a backtested edge, breaking the advisory's honest-null contract that the frozen-rubric calibration loop rewards
matrix.weekly_delta: No change — the weekly run uses the identical read off the week-end EOD book (the GO/NO_GO backtest framing is added by the orchestrator, not this agent), so sonnet/medium holds for both.
matrix.rationale: This is the fleet's smallest-blast-radius agent by explicit design: prose-only §2 advisory, 0 rubric points, schema-excluded from calls[], and its own definition file records the design intent as a 'thinking-OFF mechanical level read' (the 2026-06-12 P2.4 merge-declined note). The stale weekly table already pinned it to sonnet/thinking-off. The 2026-07-02 premium-model wins were mostly correct execution of written rules (the ZGL-null fallback is spelled out verbatim in the definition), plus one genuine judgment catch (label-vs-grid tension flagged as label-engine noise) — that catch justifies medium effort rather than low, but not opus/fable pricing on a 54k-token 0-point spawn running ~6x/week. Sonnet 5 is the current-gen workhorse for exactly this profile: strong tool use, structured output, and reliable multi-rule compliance (the ~perfect quant-compliance baseline was about the scored agents; this agent's ~9 hard rules are within sonnet's envelope). Haiku is excluded even as minimum-safe because the agent's core value on degenerate days is refusing to state a level (null ZGL, grid-miss disqualifiers) — refusing-to-overclaim and multi-constraint compliance are haiku's stated weakest axes, and the one typed artifact (next_session_gex) feeds the weekly walls backtest with no validator to catch a fabricated level. Minimum safe is sonnet/low, matching the original thinking-off design; recommended sonnet/medium buys back the artifact-detection headroom observed live at negligible cost.

matrix.workload_profile: Per run (~20 tool calls, ~60k tokens, ~5.5 min): builds dated DEX series via up to 11 `uw options-structure dex --date` calls per index/name for SPY/QQQ/IWM plus thesis-carrying single names, then applies the mechanized flip test (sign-run counting over >=3 prior sessions + flip-day |net_dex| >= 0.25x trailing-10-session median), cross-checks against gex-time-series, per-strike GEX, vanna/charm, and front-end IV ratio, and emits structured per-ticker swing reads. The workload is dominated by protocol arithmetic and threshold discipline over dated series, not open-ended synthesis; its single boolean `dex_flip_detected` (or a valid vanna flag) is the only feed into the scored +1 dealer-positioning rubric line.
precision_critical_duties: Mechanized DEX-flip determination (2026-06-12 P0.4): sign(net_dex) opposite to >=3 consecutive prior sessions AND flip-day |net_dex| >= 0.25x trailing-10-session median, computed from dated calls — the ONLY definition allowed to feed the scored +1 line; a level is never a flip

Honest near-miss refusals at thresholds — live run left MU unscored at 0.209x < 0.25x floor, QQQ unscored on run-length failure despite 1.08x magnitude, IWM DQ'd on whipsaw; overclaiming any of these injects a false +1 into the frozen rubric

Vanna-squeeze gating: flag may only fire with a dated, citable ^VIX series (Yahoo chart API); with no clean 2026 VIX source the correct output is UNVERIFIABLE, never a remembered VIX value (explicit P0.4 ban)

Evidence-string contract: both dated net_dex values must be cited (e.g. '6/10 -58.1B -> 6/11 +9.3B, prior 3 sessions negative, 0.4x median') — the calibration audit's reconstructed-citation rule grades this
Emit UNAVAILABLE for dex_trajectory_5d when dated calls were not spent; apply all four disqualifiers (INSUFFICIENT_DATA, DEX/vanna disagreement, rising-VIX vanna, unconfirmed single-day GEX flip)
Output discipline (P1.6): no file writes, no watchlist mutation, no 0DTE calls (gamma-flip-tracker owns intraday)
downgrade_failure_modes: Level-as-flip regression: emitting dex_flip_detected=true on a large net_dex LEVEL with no sign change in the window — the exact 2026-06-11 failure (MU/MRVL/ASML scored with no sign change anywhere in their 10d windows) that demoted this line +3->+1 and forced P0.4 mechanization; recurrence silently inflates raw scores and taints the pre-registered dex-flip backtest that is the line's only path back to +3

Threshold hand-waving at the 0.25x median floor: a weaker model scores an MU-style 0.209x near-miss as 'close enough', or mis-computes the trailing-10-session median of |net_dex| (haiku is weakest at exactly this protocol arithmetic), converting an unscored honest null into a false +1

Sign-run miscount: a QQQ-style zero-crossing with 1.08x magnitude passes the magnitude floor but fails the >=3-consecutive-prior-opposite-sign requirement; counting sign runs across 11 dated calls per index is multi-constraint bookkeeping that degrades first on haiku and on low-effort sonnet

Vanna flag fired from remembered VIX: with no clean 2026 ^VIX source (repo memory), a weaker model fills the falling-VIX leg from training memory instead of flagging UNVERIFIABLE — a P0.4-banned out-of-band fill that produces an invalid scored vanna disjunct the audit can only catch retrospectively

Evidence-string contract break: citing only one dated value or paraphrasing instead of quoting both dated net_dex values, tripping the calibration audit's reconstructed-citation P0-cap or letting signal-confluence-quant accept an unauditable +1
Invented dex_trajectory_5d instead of UNAVAILABLE when the dated-call budget was not spent on a name, and skipped disqualifier checks (e.g. vanna squeeze kept alive while VIX is rising)

The Phase-1 sonnet downgrades are defensible because every one is backstopped by a fable quant that re-audits or caps their feeds. However, the matrix has three defects I overrule. (1) The debate-pair 'practical split' (bear=opus, bull=sonnet) rests on an arithmetically false claim: I verified in risk-monitor.md that the debate gate is the literal comparison bear_residual >= bull_residual -> -1 tier, so an opus bear reading the transcript CANNOT compensate for a sycophantic sonnet bull — a bull inflated to 0.95 raises the bar the honest bear at 0.85 fails to clear, silently disarming the fleet's only disconfirmation gate, and both numbers land verbatim in decision.json debate_residuals where they poison C43 gate-discrimination grading. The bull residual is exactly as gate-load-bearing as the bear residual; the split's 'cheap failure direction' framing under-weights this. (2) The pair-level minimum_safe of sonnet/medium applies to the bear too, contradicting the matrix's own logic that the bear is the safety net whose silent failure is expensive — its own failure-mode list says medium-effort bears degrade to generic worry-lists. verdicts.overall_assessment: The matrix is substantively implementable at the MODEL level and mostly internally consistent, but it is silent on mechanism, and mechanism is where it currently breaks. Verified facts: none of the 16 agent files has a `model:` frontmatter field today — every agent inherits the session model, so ALL model recommendations require adding frontmatter pins (a supported, repo-precedented mechanism: calibration-audit.md already uses `model: opus`). The sonnet/opus recommendations (13 of 16 agents) are implementable as-is via `model: sonnet|opus` frontmatter, and because every row's weekly_delta is "no change," a single static per-file pin covers both commands plus ad-hoc use with no per-command switching needed — a genuine mechanical convenience the matrix earned by keeping daily/weekly tiers identical. Three things are NOT implementable as written: (1) the entire recommended_effort / minimum_safe_effort column — there is no verified per-agent effort or thinking frontmatter field, so high/medium/low distinctions can only be approximated via prompt-level thinking instructions in the agent body or session settings, and "minimum_safe_effort: low" (gamma-flip-tracker, opex-pin-strategist) cannot force effort BELOW the session default at all; (2) the two "fable" recommendations (signal-confluence-quant, risk-monitor) — fable is not a documented frontmatter alias (sonnet/opus/haiku/inherit are), so the mechanism is `model: inherit` (or omitting the field) plus a documented requirement that both commands run in a fable session, which silently degrades if invoked from a cheaper session; (3) the bull+bear combined row is internally inconsistent — its structured fields say opus/high for the pair while its own rationale prescribes a split (bear=opus/high, bull=sonnet/high); since these are two separate agent files that each need their own frontmatter value, the row as-written would pin bull-researcher.md to opus against its own cost argument. Finally, the matrix repeatedly notes the weekly table is "stale/superseded" but no row actually orders the file edits: weekly-analysis.md's routing table + line-60 prompt-header mechanism is inert (a `Model:` line in prompt text does not change the model) and references a retired model name — it must be deleted or replaced by the frontmatter pins as single source of truth, and gamma-flip-tracker.md line 10's embedded "runs thinking-OFF" prose should be reworded since it claims a config nothing enforces and now contradicts the sonnet/medium recommendation.
